questions.question: Which statement most accurately describes “atomic orbital”?

options.label: A
options.text: A model of chemical bonding where covalent bonds form from the overlap of atomic orbitals, sharing electron pairs between atoms.

options.label: B
options.text: A strong covalent bond formed by direct, head-on overlap of atomic or hybrid orbitals along the internuclear axis.

options.label: C
options.text: A mathematical wave function describing the three-dimensional region of space where an electron is most likely to be found.

options.label: D
options.text: The specific arrangement of electrons in an atom's orbitals according to the Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle, and Hund's rule.
